# doc-section-diff

> Compare two versions of a Markdown document section by section with stable section ids and content hashes, and report what a RAG index must add, drop, rename or re-embed Python package `trysac-doc-section-diff`, import name `doc_section_diff`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
